source_verified_difference: Existing generator creates a roughly 4.8 m long, 1.175 m wide four-level double-sided gondola with cartons only and shelf endcaps. Requested new asset is 1.2 x 0.5 x 1.8 m, five levels per face with boxes, cans, bags and blank end signs.
decision: Build a distinct original asset; preserve all existing models.
